author: CrazedBuffoon87
quote:
This is not GTA.

I wanted to explore Miami (Vice City) so badly, but this game was not made for people who actually wanted a crime simulator. This is supposed to be a CRIME SIMULATOR. I could write a better story if you gave me 1 day. 

The fact that you can kill some people but not others (certain character types are invincible because they are "special") is insane in what is supposed to be the best sandbox on earth.
You cant steal every car, no prostitutes, 99% leftist/Gen Z humor and writing, and the list goes on.

I knew this was going to happen, because all entertainment these days is created through the lens of the most hypocritical and pollitically correct people ever conceived. It feels like the game is more interested in lecturing than being a crime simulator 

If you like GTA, stay away.
